item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines a blocking `sleeper` using `time.sleep`, wraps it with `dspy.asyncify`, and invokes the asyncified callable in the workload."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `asyncio.gather(*[async_sleeper(delay) for _ in range(tasks)])` to fan out concurrent calls."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Runs the gathered batch inside `dspy.context(async_max_workers=workers)` and tests two settings: 1 and 4 workers."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Measures elapsed time around the awaited batch and asserts the 4-worker run is materially faster than the 1-worker run."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Imports `get_limiter`, checks singleton reuse, and verifies `total_tokens` changes with `async_max_workers`, tying timing to the active limiter."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
